metadata.name: sra_manifest_to_concatenated_fastqs_ (release v0.5)
annotations: This workflow takes as input a SRA_manifest from SRA Run Selector and will generate one fastq file or fastq pair of file for each experiment (concatenated multiple runs if necessary). Output will be relabelled to match the column specified by the user.
